dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You don't plan on taking the shell back with you, Miss Sangonomiya?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: No, I think it's better if it stays here with Idyia.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Watatsumi Island has something new to treasure now, and slowly but surely, people are seeing progress in pursuing their aspirations.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: It'll be of more use here, where it can protect this bottle domain, and the dreams of all who journey through here.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: ...If we start at Aaru Village and take a slight detour, we'll be able to see Caravan Ribat and Pardis Dhyai on the way to Sumeru City...

dialogues.speaker: Lessig
dialogues.text: Planning to do any souvenir shopping along the way? You can just focus on buying the gifts, I'll carry the bags!

dialogues.speaker: Lessig
dialogues.text: Don't worry about the weight, I can handle it! As long as it's nothing too gigantic, I'll fit it in the bag!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Calm down, how many people do you think we'll be buying for...?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Mom, Albedo, Master Jean, Razor... Ooh, and Diona, and Mona, and Fischl...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: So, Klee, what are you planning to buy for everyone?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Ummm... Sunsettia-flavor candies! And big Fungi caps! And, and...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: ...And loads and loads of storybooks for everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But I haven't decided what to get for Mom yet...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: There's no rush. Let's see what they've got, and if you're still unsure, we can help you decide.
